pairs.subject: retry-backoff
pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:100 auto-heal cap is looked up by row id in session useState while each retry mints a new row whose persisted attempt (src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:963) is never read, so every child failure is healed afresh and the lineage is unbounded - re-confirmed at registry 5058b962c (rev 14)

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:100 rung read from an in-memory HealingAttempt keyed by row id (created at SelfHealingPanel.tsx:46 useState), never from dev_tasks.attempt persisted at src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:963 - attempt count does not live in the row, the budget resets on remount and on every new child id, and no exhaustion terminal state exists

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:45 retry class is decided by regexes over the joined error/description/title strings, re-parsing message text downstream of the boundary - a task whose title mentions 'type error' is classed build_error and auto-retried regardless of its real failure

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:56 the only stop vocabulary is pending/healing/healed/failed in session memory - exhausted vs reclassified vs denied are not spelled, and the cap-hit toast (SelfHealingPanel.tsx:62) is not recorded anywhere

pairs.registryProposal: durable-retries step 3 is written for a single row that is rescheduled; a lineage that mints a child row per attempt (parent_task_id + attempt) satisfies 'attempt lives in the row' only if the budget check reads the newest child's attempt - worth one sentence naming the per-attempt-row shape and that the cap keys on lineage root, not on the row id
